happy.desc: The frozen scope evidence records current main/story HEAD, materialHash, suiteRunId, clean .lattice artifact root, and F-009 finding snapshot.

adversarial.desc: The frozen scope explicitly excludes .omx and does not allow disabled legacy roots or mixed stale proof roots.
